label: Peplink MAX Transit (LTE-A, CAT-6, worldwide)
description: Transportation router with one LTE-A CAT-6 modem: 1x GE WAN (convertible), 1x GE LAN, 400 Mbps throughput, Wi-Fi.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink tech-spec sheet: Ethernet WAN port 1 / 0 (GE), Number of Ethernet LAN port 1 / 2 (GE), Router Throughput 400 Mbps, Wi-Fi AP Yes. **CAT-6 and CAT-12 Transits share this sheet and this 400 Mbps ceiling** - the modem category changes the cellular rate available from the carrier, not what the chassis forwards, so the port and throughput rows cannot tell the two apart.
